records.text: On 2023-01-20 at 4:04 pm, Gina and Jon met and greeted each other; Gina asked Jon what was new.
Jon lost his job as a banker on 2023-01-19, the day before the conversation.
Jon plans to start his own business after losing his banker job.
Gina lost her job at Door Dash in January 2023.
Jon is starting a dance studio because he is passionate about dancing and wants to teach others the joy dancing brings him.
Jon has been into dancing since he was a kid, and dancing has been his passion and escape.
Jon loves all dances, but contemporary is his top pick; he finds contemporary dance expressive and powerful.
Gina uses dance as her go-to for stress relief, and her favorite dance style is contemporary, which she finds expressive and graceful.
Jon and Gina agreed to attend a dance class or dance session together on Friday 2023-01-27, the next Friday after 2023-01-20.
On 2023-01-20, Jon shared a photo of a man in a suit performing a dance during the conversation with Gina.
Jon was excited about the planned dance session with Gina and said it was going to be great.
Jon's dance crew won first place in a local dance competition in 2022; Jon found being on stage amazing and is keen to spread that intensity to other people.
Gina used to compete in dance competitions and shows; her favorite memory is her team winning first place at a regional competition when she was 15.
Gina shared a photo of a couple of people standing next to each other.
Gina's team performed a contemporary piece called "Finding Freedom" at the regional competition; Gina found it emotional and powerful.
Gina shared a photo of a large open porch with a fireplace and a view of the water.
Jon shared a photo of his ideal dance studio by the water: a room with a view of the ocean and a few yoga mats.
Gina thought Jon's ideal dance studio setup was cool and said the view was undeniable.
Jon hopes he and Gina will find a place like his ideal dance studio by the water that will inspire them.
Jon rehearses with a small group of dancers after work; they do all kinds of dances, from contemporary to hip-hop.
Jon's dance group is finishing choreography to perform at a nearby festival in February 2023.
Jon shared a photo of a group of dancers in white dresses on a stage.
The dancers in Jon's photo are his group performing at the festival; they have been practicing hard and Jon says they will impress with grace and skill.
Gina said the dancers looked awesome and graceful and she can't wait to see them rock the festival.
Jon is glad to be part of the festival.
On 2023-01-29 Gina launched an ad campaign for her clothing store to grow the business; she says starting her own store and taking risks is both scary and rewarding.
Gina owns a clothing store; on 2023-01-29 she shared a photo of the store with a variety of clothes on display.
Jon thinks Gina's clothing store looks great and that her hard work paid off; he finds it awesome that her stuff is on display.

As of 2023-01-29 Jon is hunting for the ideal spot for his dance studio; he found a place downtown with great natural light that is easy to get to, and still needs to check its size and floor quality.
Jon shared a photo of a bathroom with a blue floor and a pink wall in connection with his studio search and Paris trip.
Jon visited Paris on 2023-01-28 and found it very cool.
Gina has never visited Paris; she has been to Rome once.

Jon wants Marley flooring for his dance studio because it is grippy yet still lets you move, and it is tough and easy to keep clean; he needs a dance floor with enough bounce so he and his students can dance safely.

Gina agrees that good dance floors help avoid injuries and make dancing more enjoyable, and thinks Marley flooring is perfect with the right amount of grip and movement; she can't wait to see Jon's dance studio done.
Jon describes finding the right place and getting everything ready for his dance studio as a mix of exciting and nerve-wracking, but he is determined to make it work.
Gina advises Jon to believe in himself, push through the tough process, and to take breaks and dance it out when he needs to destress.
Jon is glad to have Gina in his corner and says they will make it through; Gina appreciates Jon's support, and both agree to keep chasing their dreams and making their goals happen.
Jon told Gina he is still following his passion for dance and still searching for a place to open his dance studio, saying it has been bumpy but he is determined to make it work.
Gina emailed some wholesalers and one replied and said yes on 2023-02-01, which means she can expand her clothing store and get closer to her customers; she said she is over the moon.
Gina shared a photo with Jon of a shopping mall with a glass entrance and a sign, showing the spot she found for her clothing store.
Jon told Gina she found the perfect spot for her store and that her hard work is paying off.
Jon shared a photo with Gina of a room with a mirror and a wooden floor.

Gina shared a photo with Jon of the space she designed for her clothing store: a cozy and inviting clothing store with a lot of clothes on display, which she says is perfect for customers to check out all the trendy pieces.
Gina wants her clothing store space to be cozy and inviting, with trendy pieces displayed for customers to browse.
Jon complimented Gina's store design, saying it looks great, and asked what made her pick out the furniture and decor.

Gina says designing her store took a bit of time; she wanted it to look like her own style and make her customers feel cozy. She chose furniture that looks great and is comfy too. The chandelier adds a glam feel while matching the store's style.
Jon thinks Gina's store looks great and her customers will be very comfortable.
Gina says making her store comfortable and inviting for customers is key; she wants them to feel like they're in a cool oasis and to create an experience that makes them want to come back.
Jon believes creating a special experience for customers is the key to making them feel welcome and come back, and he thinks Gina can create the space she's imagining.
Gina says Jon's support means a lot; she is sure that with hard work and effort she can make a special shopping experience for her customers. She finds it tough but is up for the challenge.
Jon tells Gina he is always there to support her and encourages her to create something awesome with her store.
Gina encourages Jon about his dance studio, telling him to keep going and stay positive, and says they'll get through this together.
Jon says Gina's words mean a lot; he is staying positive and pushing forward. He says they have put their hearts into their dreams and he is sure they will make it.
Gina tells Jon to stay motivated and keep going, saying hard work pays off eventually and they can do this.
As of 2023-02-04, Gina said her clothing store was doing great and described running it as a wild ride.
As of 2023-02-04, Jon said he was putting a lot of work into his business despite obstacles and was determined to make it happen.
Gina told Jon he has drive and that if he keeps it up he will definitely make a splash.
Jon told Gina that sometimes it is hard when things do not go his way, but he is sure that if he keeps pushing he will reach his dreams.
Gina told Jon that setbacks are opportunities for comebacks, that he has skills, passion, and drive, and that she gives him her full support.
Jon said Gina's support means a lot and that with her support he can handle anything.
Jon said searching for a dance studio location has been tricky, but he is determined to find the right spot and believes the rest will follow once he does.
Jon said he is working on his business and new dance routines, and is rehearsing hard for an upcoming show; dancing brings him joy and fulfillment.
On 2023-02-04, Jon shared a photo of a woman in a gray dress doing a trick.
Jon is preparing for a dance competition near Jon next month (March 2023); he sees it as a chance to show his skills and get props from the dance community, and he is super stoked.
Gina told Jon he is going to kill it in the dance competition and that his hard work and talent will pay off.
Jon said he will do his best to make Gina proud and that he is going for his dreams.
Gina told Jon that his passion and commitment are awesome, that she will always cheer him on, and that he should believe in himself.
Jon told Gina her kind words mean a lot and that he will not give up.
Gina told Jon she found a cool new fashion piece for her store and couldn't wait to share it with her customers, sharing a photo of a group of women posing with a giant balloon.

Jon performed at the festival he had mentioned previously; it went awesome with many people complimenting his dance moves, and it reminded him why he is passionate about dancing. He shared a photo of a group of young girls in a dance studio.
Gina told Jon he looked badass on stage at his festival performance.

Jon's favorite part of running his own dance studio is having the freedom to create a space and help dancers of all ages and levels express themselves; he is thrilled about dancing each day, loves seeing his students progress, and finds it fulfilling.
Gina has been working hard on her online store and just teamed up with a local artist for cool new designs, sharing a photo of a rack of clothes with a coat and a dress.

Gina got the idea for her new designs from a fashion magazine after noticing there wasn't much like it around; she worked with the local artist to make it happen, aiming to stay ahead of the game and give customers something different.
Jon said Gina never shies away from a challenge and always tries something new; he is impressed by her willingness to take risks and finds it inspiring.
Gina believes taking risks is scary but is the only way to grow, and sees it as part of the journey to success.

Jon agrees taking risks is key for success; it made him grow and got him out of his secure 9-5 job as a banker. He is aiming to turn his dancing passion into a business, is determined to make it work, but does not underestimate the difficulties, saying it has not been a walk in the park.

Gina reassured Jon that starting a business is tough but not to let it get him down, that he can make his studio work, and that she is always there for him; Jon said her help means a lot and that he will keep plugging away and stay optimistic.
Jon shared a photo of a cartoon character with a quote about fear, saying it keeps him going.

Gina said the quote about fear kept her positive through tough times, that everyone needs a push sometimes, and that she even got a tattoo to remind herself of it; she shared a photo of a woman standing on a balcony in a blue dress.
On 2023-02-08 at 9:32 am, Jon complimented Gina's tattoo and asked whether she had just gotten it.
Gina has a tattoo that she got a few years before 2023-02-08; it stands for freedom—dancing without worrying what people think—and reminds her to follow her passions and express herself.
Jon told Gina that freedom and expressing ourselves without worry are important; dance gives Jon an escape to be himself.
Jon shared a photo of a woman in a tutu posing for a picture during Jon's 2023-02-08 conversation with Gina.
Gina agreed with Jon that dancing lets people be themselves and said the feeling is unlike anything else; she called Jon dedicated to his studio and inspiring.
Jon plans to keep chasing his dreams, keep working hard, and make dance a success, saying dance is his passion.
Jon shared a photo of a trophy with a glass globe on top during Jon's 2023-02-08 conversation with Gina.
Gina asked Jon how he had been juggling dance and business goals.

Jon finds juggling dance and running his business tricky but rewarding; dancing and the business give him energy for each other, his dance moves pump him to tackle business goals, and business successes boost his drive to keep dreaming on the dance floor.
Gina told Jon he is amazing at juggling both his passions and that finding a happy medium is key; she encouraged him to keep going and not stop dreaming.
Jon told Gina her pep-talk meant a lot; he said he will not give up on his dreams and that his dance studio and business ventures need the hard work he is putting in.
Jon loves having Gina in his corner and thanked her for always being there; Gina said she is there for Jon; they agreed to keep chasing dreams, help each other, and move forward together.
Jon started hitting the gym during the week of 2023-03-06 to 2023-03-12 to stay on track with his venture.
On 2023-03-16, Jon said balancing the gym, venture, and other commitments was tricky but going well.
On 2023-03-16, Jon told Gina he had been hectic lately and asked how she was doing.
On 2023-03-16, Gina told Jon she had been having tough times lately.
On 2023-03-16, Jon offered to help Gina after she said she was having tough times.
On 2023-03-16, Gina said that since losing her Door Dash job in January 2023, things had been tough.
On 2023-03-16, Gina thanked Jon and said she appreciated his offer to help.
On 2023-03-16, Gina told Jon she had good news to share, but did not reveal what it was.
On 2023-03-16, Jon said he was excited and could not wait to hear Gina's good news.
On 2023-03-16 at 2:35 pm, Gina announced that her online clothes store is open and said she had been dreaming of it for a while.
Gina shared a photo of a computer screen showing a book and a pair of shoes when announcing the opening of her online clothes store.
Jon congratulated Gina and asked what gave her the idea to start the online store.
Gina said she is passionate about fashion trends and finding unique pieces.
Gina said she wanted to blend her love for dance and fashion, so opening the online clothes store was a perfect match.
Jon said combining Gina's two interests into a store is super cool and wished her the best of luck with it.
Jon shared a photo of three young girls standing next to each other with trophies.
Gina asked Jon how his business is going and said she hoped it is going well.

Jon told Gina that losing his job was hard, but he is living his dreams now; starting his business has been tough but he is going to make it, he keeps facing new challenges, and he is sure it will be worth it in the end.
Jon shared a photo of a laptop computer sitting on top of a table.
Gina told Jon that starting and running her own business has had ups and downs but has been an amazing ride.
Jon told Gina that running a business has been a rollercoaster, that Gina's success inspires him to keep pushing forward, and that her determination is awesome.
Gina thanked Jon and said his words are really encouraging, and she is glad her journey is inspiring others.
Jon said it is great that he and Gina face the same challenges, that it motivates them, and that it is like having a partner to dance with.
Gina said she and Jon are on different paths, but it is nice to have someone to root for them, and they can do it.
Jon said having someone back them up is great and proposed that he and Gina keep going and reach success together.
Gina proposed that she and Jon keep chasing their dreams, supporting each other, and celebrating achievements, saying they can do great things together.
Jon thanked Gina for having his back and toasted to taking on new heights and all the trials that come with it, saying cheers.
Jon shared a photo of two glasses of champagne with a bottle of wine in the background.
On 2023-03-23 at 7:28 pm, Jon greeted Gina and asked how she was doing.
On 2023-03-23 at 7:28 pm, Gina told Jon that her online clothing store had been a roller coaster but rewarding; she said starting a business takes courage and encouraged Jon to hang in there.

On 2023-03-23 at 7:28 pm, Jon thanked Gina, said his business had been tough but he was going to make it happen, said it had been great, called Gina awesome with her store, and asked how her store was going.

On 2023-03-23 at 7:28 pm, Gina thanked Jon, appreciated his kind words, said her store was going good, said she had been keeping up with fashion trends to offer the best pieces to customers, said it was a lot of work but she really enjoyed it, and asked Jon for advice or tips on running a successful business.
Gina enjoys running her online clothing store despite the hard work and keeps up with fashion trends so she can offer the best pieces to customers.
Gina and Jon continue to encourage and support each other's business dreams in their conversations.

Jon advised Gina on her online clothing store: brand identity is key and her brand must stand out; she should build relationships with customers and let them know she cares; she should stay positive and motivate others because her energy will be contagious.

Gina thanked Jon for his advice and said that building relationships and creating a strong brand image for her online clothing store is something she is always working on; she agreed that staying positive is key, and asked Jon what helps him stay motivated with his dance studio business.
Jon said that seeing his dance students succeed motivates him; he finds it awesome to help them learn and reach their goals.
Jon shared a photo of a group of women doing a dance routine, from around one of his dance classes, and said Gina's support means a lot to him.
Gina called Jon's students' growth and success awesome and said seeing them grow and succeed must be really fulfilling; she is glad she can be part of Jon's journey.
Jon thanked Gina for being there for him and said her support has made a huge difference and feels great; her help means a lot to him.
Gina told Jon she is glad she could help, that it is nice to be part of something positive, that supporting his dreams is awesome, and that she is here for him and rooting for him all the way.
Gina encouraged Jon to keep going and never give up, and told him to believe in himself even when it is tough.
Jon said Gina's words motivate him to keep going; he will not quit, will keep believing in himself, and thanked her for the kind words.
Gina and Jon mutually encourage and support each other's business dreams: Gina supports Jon's dance studio business, and Jon supports Gina's online clothing store.
On 2023-04-03 Jon told Gina he had to shut down his bank account, calling it a tough decision he made for his dance studio business.
Jon said shutting down his bank account was a tough call but he hoped it would help his business grow; he found handling the changes hard but was staying positive and looking ahead.
Gina told Jon she has new offers and promotions going on at her online clothing store to try to bring in new customers.
Gina said starting her business has been a wild ride but she is not giving up; Jon praised her for never giving up.
Gina's sources of motivation are dance, which is her stress relief, and fashion, which fuels her creativity; she loves finding new trends for her store, which keeps her motivated to keep growing.
Gina shared a photo of her favorite dance session with Jon: a photo of a man and woman doing a yoga pose.
Gina is passionate about both dance and fashion; combining them lets her show her creativity and share her love with others, and she adds dance-inspired items to her store.

Gina said customers love her new offers and promotions and she is seeing more sales; people seem to really like her designs, she is always hunting for unique trendy pieces, and growing her customer base is her main focus.

Gina plans to work with fashion bloggers and influencers in the next few months and to run more ads, aiming to reach more people, grow her customer base, and make her store a top destination for fashion fans.
Jon is expanding his dance studio's social media presence and offering workshops and classes to local schools and centers.
Jon is hosting a dance competition in May 2023 to showcase local talent and bring more attention to his dance studio.
Jon said all his work is paying off, he is seeing progress and his dancers are excited; he loves giving people a place where they can express themselves through dance.
Gina told Jon she is proud of the progress his dance studio has made and encouraged him to keep it up.
Jon said Gina's backing means a lot to him, that his plan has been tough, and that her encouragement really helps him.
Jon shared a photo with Gina of a group of people on a stage with a projector screen and invited her to his dance competition event in May 2023.
Gina reacted to Jon's event photo, said the event looked cool, and said she would love to join in and show her support.
Jon said his dance studio and some other schools are bringing their best moves for a night of performances and judging at the competition, and that it will be creative and fun.
Jon shared a photo with Gina of a group of dancers on a stage with a man in the middle of the group.
Gina wants to attend Jon's May 2023 dance competition to show her support for his studio.
Gina tells Jon she is definitely in for the show and shares a photo of a woman in a tutu posing for a picture.
Jon replies he can't wait to see Gina and shares a photo of two women doing a handstand in a room.
Gina thanks Jon and says she will see him at the event, sharing a photo of a group of young girls in tutus and ballet shoes.
Jon wishes Gina good luck with her online clothing store and shares a photo of a dress with a sign on it that says 'june bunty'.
Gina thanks Jon and says she appreciates his kind words.
Jon tells Gina he is always there for her and shares a photo of a street light on a sidewalk in front of a building.
Gina says Jon's support means a lot to her; she will keep pursuing her goals and hopes Jon does too.
Jon says he won't quit on his dreams and that Gina's words really motivate him.
Gina says goodbye to Jon, encouraging him to believe in himself and keep pushing, and to take care.

On 9 April 2023, Jon told Gina he is turning his love of dance into a business, has sunk tons of time into his dance studio, said his students are already killing it, and that he is learning alongside them; he shared a photo of a group of dancers on a stage with a red background.
On 9 April 2023, Gina praised Jon for turning his passion for dance into a business and said his dance studio looks awesome; she shared a photo of a display of a dress and a flamingo.
On 9 April 2023, Jon told Gina he is determined to make his dance studio work, and that losing his job was tough but gave him the push he needed to do what he loves.

On 9 April 2023, Gina told Jon that tough times can be a gateway to awesome things and that she is glad he worked up the courage to go after his dreams; she shared a photo of a red dress with gold accents on a mannequin.

On 9 April 2023, Jon told Gina that although things have been tough he is living his true self, that dancing makes him very happy, that he now gets to share that with other people, and that seeing his students improve brings him great joy; he shared a photo of a woman doing a pole dance in a dance studio.
On 9 April 2023, Gina told Jon he looks so happy when he dances and encouraged him to show the world his true self and keep dancing.

Jon says dancing is his way to express himself and find his happy place; he used to be scared to death of what people would think but learned that his own happiness is the most important thing, calling it tough but the best thing ever.

On 9 April 2023, Gina told Jon she remembers their dance classes, that she used to love spending time in the studio, and that his photo brought back lots of memories; she noted it is nice to know dance is still his happy place, and shared a photo of a group of young women in ballet attire.

On 9 April 2023, Jon told Gina he is happy that dance has such a special meaning to both of them, that it is a cool way to express themselves, that he loved taking lessons with his friends when he was younger, that those memories are precious, that he is glad he can still enjoy dance with his own studio, and thanked Gina for always being there for him.

Gina considers dance awesome for expressing yourself and finding happiness, and told Jon on 9 April 2023 that she has his back on that; she shared a photo of one of her trophies from a dance contest, a trophy with a glass globe on top, as a reminder of the hard work, dedication and joy dance brings.

On 2023-04-09, Jon told Gina that something looked awesome and thanked her for her support, saying it meant a lot; Gina told Jon he earned all the kudos for his hard work and encouraged him to keep it up; Jon said he would keep pushing and working hard and would not let anything hold him back; Gina replied that he should keep it up and that he is almost there.
Jon said on 2023-04-09 that he is going to keep pushing and working hard and will not let anything hold him back.
Gina believes Jon earned all the kudos for his hard work and encouraged him on 2023-04-09, telling him he is almost there and to keep it up.
On 24 April 2023, Jon attended a fair to show off his dance studio; it was both stressful and great, and he got some possible leads.
Jon learned that running a business is no cakewalk and that having confidence in yourself is important for making it successful.
Jon shared a photo of a group of women performing a dance on a stage.
Gina congratulated Jon on the fair and told him it was awesome to see his hard work paying off, encouraging him to keep pushing and that he is headed for greatness.
Gina started her own online clothing store not long before 25 April 2023.
Gina shared a photo of a laptop with a sale ad on the screen.
Jon told Gina her store looks great and that he remembers it.
Gina lost her job and wanted to take control of her own destiny, so she started her online clothing store; it has been a tough journey but very rewarding.
Jon thinks Gina is awesome for going for it, and believes setbacks can help people reach their potential.
Jon said he is having trouble with his business project and asked Gina for advice on staying motivated when times are tough.
Gina advised Jon that challenges are awesome for learning and growth; to stay motivated she thinks of the big goal and why she is doing it, gets help from supportive people, and dances it out.
Jon has been feeling low on confidence lately and finds it hard to run a business without faith in himself; he asked Gina for tips on staying confident in business.

Gina advised Jon that confidence is important in business; she stays motivated by reminding herself of her successes and progress, having a good support system, and focusing on why she started because she loves it; she told Jon to have faith in himself and that she does.
Jon said Gina's words mean a lot, that he will focus on success and why he started, and that he loves it, which will keep his confidence up.
Gina told Jon he is incredibly talented and passionate about dance, and encouraged him to believe in himself and his abilities, tackle any obstacle, and keep shining.
Jon plans to keep going and reach his dreams no matter what.
Gina told Jon to go for it and not let anything stop him, saying they are in this together.
Jon and Gina agreed to keep pushing each other on their business paths and keep each other going.
Jon shared a photo of a woman in a short skirt with her hands on her hips during the chat.
Jon said that since last speaking he is still working on the dance studio and things are looking up.
Gina told Jon he is inspiring for taking on and opening his own dance studio.
Jon said losing his job gave him the push to finally start his dream business, his own dance studio, and he is stepping into the unknown hoping for the best.

Gina encouraged Jon, saying it must be scary stepping into the unknown but his determination and drive will make his dance studio a huge success, and told him to keep his positive outlook and keep going.
Jon said starting the dance studio is a bit scary, but he thinks about his love for dance and how it makes him feel.
Jon said dance has been his stress-buster since childhood, helps him de-stress, is where he feels most alive, and is a must-have in his life.
Gina said dance is her stress fix too; as soon as she starts, all her worries vanish, and it is amazing what they can do for their own mental health with something they enjoy.
Gina said dance is just her and she cannot picture life without it, comparing it to air.
Jon said dancing is like second nature to him and he is living his dream by having his own dance studio and teaching others.
Jon wants to create a place for people to dance and express themselves through his dance studio, which has been a dream of his.
Gina said Jon is living the dream and inspiring others, his studio will totally change things for lots of folks and make a huge difference, and she cannot wait to see it happen.
Jon told Gina her help means a lot to him.
Jon plans to keep Gina posted on the dance studio progress.
Gina had an interview for a design internship on 2023-05-10.
Gina said her design internship interview went great.
Jon is working on a cool project and has been keeping Gina in the loop about it.
Gina appreciates Jon keeping her in the loop on his cool project.
Gina is excited to hear more about Jon's project and watch it come to life.
Jon said taking a risk is scary but believes following his dreams will pay off in the end.
Jon reacted with excitement to Gina's news and asked how her design internship interview went.
On 2023-05-11, Jon told Gina he has been practicing dance routines lately and that dancing keeps his mind focused and motivated.
On 2023-05-11, Gina praised Jon for practicing dance, said dancing is awesome for staying focused, and asked him to show her one of his routines sometime.
Jon agreed to show Gina one of his dance routines and plans to send her a video of it, asking her to let him know when she has time.
Gina told Jon she will watch his dance routine video and said she is very proud of him.
Jon thanked Gina and said her help means a lot to him; he promised to get the dance routine video to her soon.
records.topic: Gratitude and support between Jon and Gina

records.text: Gina told Jon it's no problem and that she is always there to help, and said she can't wait to see the dance routine video.
Gina told Jon on 2023-05-27 that Gina just got accepted for a fashion internship.
Jon congratulated Gina on 2023-05-27 for Gina's fashion internship acceptance and asked where the internship is and how Gina feels about it.
Gina's new fashion internship is a part-time position in the fashion department of an international company, as Gina told Jon on 2023-05-27.
Gina is excited and kind of nervous about starting the fashion internship and considers it a big change, as Gina told Jon on 2023-05-27.
Gina shared a photo with Jon on 2023-05-27 showing a laptop computer with a logo on the screen.
Jon told Gina on 2023-05-27 that Gina stepped up, congratulated Gina, and asked Gina what Gina's plan for the future is.
Jon shared a photo with Gina on 2023-05-27 showing a book with a yellow and green cover.
Gina is a mix of excited and scared to get into fashion, and Gina is trying to stay upbeat and learn as much as Gina can, as Gina told Jon on 2023-05-27.
Gina asked Jon on 2023-05-27 whether Jon had something new.
Jon is currently reading the book "The Lean Startup", hoping it will give him tips for his dance studio business.
Gina asked Jon whether "The Lean Startup" could spark new ideas for his dance studio.
Jon said "The Lean Startup" got him thinking about building a focused and efficient business, and that adapting and tweaking from customer feedback is important; he plans to try it out.
Jon shared a photo of a whiteboard with a list of dates on it.
Gina told Jon his whiteboard had a bunch of good ideas and asked how he would keep track and stay on schedule with those dates.
Jon said the whiteboard helps him keep track of ideas and milestones, gives him a visual of his progress, and keeps him organized.
Gina said having something visual can help with organizing and motivation, and asked Jon what he is currently working on.
Jon is wrapping up his business plan and looking for investors; his passion for the project and belief in its success are driving him.
Gina said she was impressed by Jon's commitment and asked how the hunt for investors was going.
Jon said searching for investors has been tough, but he is staying hopeful and learning a lot through the process.
Gina encouraged Jon, telling him he has the right attitude and to keep learning and growing and keep going.
Jon thanked Gina for her help and said he will keep going and never quit; he shared a photo of a pink sign with a message on it.

Gina encouraged Jon to keep going, and Jon thanked her, saying her words mean a lot and he won't let anything get him down; Gina replied that obstacles are inevitable but he can do awesome things and urged him to keep going.
Jon values Gina's encouragement highly.
On 2023-06-13, Jon thanked Gina for being there for him and believing in him, saying it means a lot.
Gina replied that she is always around for Jon and asked how he has been since they last caught up.
Jon said he is prepping for his dance studio more than ever.
Gina told Jon she is proud of him for starting his own business and that it takes strength to stay hopeful, and asked what he is doing to prepare for the dance studio.
Gina has developed a video presentation to teach how to style her fashion pieces.
Gina shared a photo of a group of young girls in blue outfits posing for a picture.

Jon said working with the young dancers is inspiring, seeing their passion and commitment, and that opening the dance studio has been a great experience; he wants it to be a place of support and encouragement for all dancers.
Gina plans to send Jon her video presentation on styling fashion pieces later.
Gina shared a photo of a skeleton and a trophy on a black cloth.
Besides dance classes and workshops, Jon offers one-on-one mentoring and training to help dancers reach their full potential.
Gina had a mentor when she was learning how to dance.
Gina shared a photo of a group of people in a dance class.
Jon shared a photo of a clipboard with a notepad attached to it.
